title: Garden agent evals
description: Compare model trials, grader results, and traces. Set Run ID, Task, or Model to a value, or use * for all.

panels.title: Pass rate by task and model
panels.description: Zero is a red, visible failure. Both heatmaps use ascending model order.

queries.query: SELECT model AS x, task_id AS y, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS z FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY model, task_id ORDER BY model ASC, task_id ASC

panels.title: Pass^k by task and model
panels.description: PASS means every requested repeat passed. Zero is a red, visible failure.

queries.query: SELECT model AS x, task_id AS y, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = MAX(requested_repeats) AND SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = MAX(requested_repeats) AND SUM(CASE WHEN aborted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS z FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY model, task_id ORDER BY model ASC, task_id ASC

panels.title: Task by model grid
panels.description: FAIL is explicit for a zero pass rate or an incomplete pass^k cell.

queries.query: SELECT task_id, model, COUNT(*) AS trials, SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_rate_percent, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = MAX(requested_repeats) AND SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = MAX(requested_repeats) AND SUM(CASE WHEN aborted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS pass_k FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY task_id, model ORDER BY task_id ASC, model ASC

panels.title: Tool calls, tokens, and duration
panels.description: Grouped by task and model. Values keep their native units: calls, tokens, and seconds.

queries.query: SELECT CONCAT(task_id, ' / ', model) AS x, 'Tool calls' AS series, AVG(tool_calls) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY task_id, model UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(task_id, ' / ', model) AS x, 'Tokens' AS series, AVG(tokens) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY task_id, model UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(task_id, ' / ', model) AS x, 'Duration seconds' AS series, AVG(duration_seconds) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY task_id, model ORDER BY x, series

panels.title: Pass rate trend by run
panels.description: Each point is one run and model for the selected task and model filters.

queries.query: SELECT MIN(_timestamp) AS x, AVG(CASE WHEN passed THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS y, CONCAT(run_id, ' / ', model) AS series FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' GROUP BY run_id, model ORDER BY x ASC

panels.title: Selected run summary
panels.description: These values respond to the Run ID, Task, and Model filters above.

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference'

panels.title: Passing trials
panels.description: Count of passing trials in the selected run and filters.

queries.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference'

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls in the selected run and filters.

queries.query: SELECT SUM(tool_calls) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference'

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Tokens in the selected run and filters.

queries.query: SELECT SUM(tokens) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference'

panels.title: Duration seconds
panels.description: Total duration in the selected run and filters.

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(duration_seconds), 3) AS y FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference'

panels.title: Grader verdicts
panels.description: Each row includes serialized grader verdicts and reasons from the trial record.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, run_id, task_id, model, repeat, passed, graders, failure_reason FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Trials and traces
panels.description: Open trace_link from a row, or use the trace_id field to find the trial trace.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, run_id, task_id, model, repeat, passed, tool_calls, tokens, duration_seconds, graders, failure_reason, trace_id, CONCAT('/web/traces/trace-details?stream=garden-eval-traces&trace_id=', trace_id, '&from=', CAST(_timestamp - 60000000 AS VARCHAR), '&to=', CAST(_timestamp + 60000000 AS VARCHAR), '&org_identifier=default') AS trace_link FROM "garden-eval-trials" WHERE ({{run:singlequote}} = '*' OR run_id = {{run:singlequote}}) AND ({{task:singlequote}} = '*' OR task_id = {{task:singlequote}}) AND ({{model:singlequote}} = '*' OR model = {{model:singlequote}}) AND model <> 'reference' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
